WITH nums AS (
    -- 生成 0~143 的数字，共 144 个 (24h × 6)
    SELECT ROWNUM - 1 AS n
    FROM all_objects
    WHERE ROWNUM <= 144
),
slots AS (
    -- 完整的 10 分钟桶起点（00:00, 00:10, …, 23:50）
    SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) + n * 10 / 1440 AS bucket_start
    FROM nums
),
-- 离港航班统计（实际起飞时间）
dep_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS dep_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        ON f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
        AND f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME >= s.bucket_start
        AND f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME <  s.bucket_start + 10/1440
        AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
        AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    GROUP BY s.bucket_start
),
-- 到港航班统计（实际落地时间）
arr_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS arr_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        ON f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
        AND f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME >= s.bucket_start
        AND f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME <  s.bucket_start + 10/1440
        AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
        AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    GROUP BY s.bucket_start
),
-- 合并 10 分钟桶数据
bucket_full AS (
    SELECT
        s.bucket_start,
        NVL(d.dep_cnt, 0) AS dep_cnt,
        NVL(a.arr_cnt, 0) AS arr_cnt
    FROM slots s
    LEFT JOIN dep_bucket d ON s.bucket_start = d.bucket_start
    LEFT JOIN arr_bucket a ON s.bucket_start = a.bucket_start
),
-- 滚动窗口函数：当前桶 + 前两个桶 → 30 分钟总和
rolling AS (
    SELECT
        bucket_start,
        SUM(dep_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start
                           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS depart_flights,
        SUM(arr_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start
                           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS arrive_flights,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start) AS rn,
        LAG(bucket_start, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket_start) AS win_start
    FROM bucket_full
)
SELECT flight_date, time_window, depart_flights, arrive_flights, total_flights
FROM (
    SELECT
        TRUNC(bucket_start) AS flight_date,
        TO_CHAR(win_start, 'HH24:MI') || ' - ' || TO_CHAR(bucket_start + 10/1440, 'HH24:MI') AS time_window,
        depart_flights,
        arrive_flights,
        depart_flights + arrive_flights AS total_flights,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY depart_flights + arrive_flights DESC, bucket_start) AS rn
    FROM rolling
    WHERE rn >= 3
)
WHERE rn = 1;

旅客吞吐量:
WITH 
-- 进港去重航班
arr_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        a.FLIGHT_ID,
        a.EXEC_DATE,
        a.CRAFT_NO,
        a.FLIGHT_NO,
        a.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
        a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
        a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            f1.CRAFT_NO,
            f2.FLIGHT_NO,
            f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD,
            f2.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA,
            f2.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'A'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_LANDIN_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) a
    WHERE a.rn = 1
),
-- 出港去重航班
dep_unique AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FLIGHT_ID,
        d.EXEC_DATE
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            f1.FLIGHT_ID,
            f2.EXEC_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f1.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || f1.FLIGHT_NO, f1.PLAN_TIME, f1.IS_OFF_IN ORDER BY f1.FLIGHT_ID) AS rn
        FROM FIMS.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f1
        LEFT JOIN ACDM.TB_DYN_FLIGHT f2 ON f1.FLIGHT_ID = f2.FLIGHT_ID
        WHERE f1.IS_OFF_IN = 'D'
          AND TRUNC(f2.REAL_TAKEOFF_TIME) = DATE '2026-06-07'
          AND NVL(f2.ABNORMAL_FLIGHT_STAT_CD, 'null') <> 'CAN'
          AND f1.FLIGHT_TASK_CD <> 'A/N'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
-- 计算进港旅客量
arr_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(fp.ADULT_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.CHILDREN_COUNT, 0) + NVL(fp.BABY_COUNT, 0)) AS arrival_pax
    FROM arr_unique a
    LEFT JOIN FORMFILL.FLIGHT_PRODUCTION_ANALYSIS fp 
        ON a.EXEC_DATE = fp.EXEC_DATE
        AND a.CRAFT_NO = fp.CRAFT_NO
        AND a.FLIGHT_NO = fp.AIRLINE_TWO_CHAR_CD || fp.FLIGHT_NO  
        AND a.TAKEOFF_AIRPORT_IATA || '-' || a.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_IATA = fp.LEG
        AND fp.AVAILABLE_SEAT != 0
),
-- 计算出港旅客量
dep_pax AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(NVL(t.DEP_DPSR_DEPE_NUM, 0)) AS departure_pax
    FROM dep_unique d
    LEFT JOIN FIMS.TBH_FIMS_DYN_CALC_TOTAL t ON d.FLIGHT_ID = t.FLIGHT_ID
)
SELECT 
    arr_pax.arrival_pax,
    dep_pax.departure_pax,
    arr_pax.arrival_pax + dep_pax.departure_pax AS total_pax
FROM arr_pax, dep_pax;
